metadata.description: Personal skills & agents, organized by domain.

plugins.name: coding-style
plugins.description: Coding-style and output discipline — Karpathy LLM-mistake guardrails (surgical changes, no overcomplication), laziest-senior-dev minimalism (ponytail: YAGNI, stdlib-first, shortest working diff), and caveman output compression. Skills: karpathy-guidelines, ponytail, caveman.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Debugging discipline plus whole-repo bug sweeps — systematic root-cause-first fixing (sleuth: investigate before editing, one hypothesis at a time, stop after three failed fixes) and a fan-out of read-only hunters (hunt + 10 hunter agents) that surface bugs across an entire codebase. Skills: sleuth, hunt.

plugins.name: hebrew-localization
plugins.description: Hebrew writing and localization for Angular-first web apps — Hebrew product and marketing copy (voice, gender-neutral address, loanwords, punctuation), removing AI tells from Hebrew text, Hebrew i18n (one/two/other plurals, he-IL dates and shekel formatting, ID validation), and RTL layout (logical properties, bidi isolation, icon mirroring, Angular CDK direction). Skills: hebrew-copywriting, hebrew-ai-tells, hebrew-i18n, hebrew-rtl-layout.

plugins.name: mushilu-studio
plugins.description: End-to-end Mushilu-San-UI component pipeline — scope, spec, build, parallel review/audit, test, docs, and release — orchestrated as one workflow.

plugins.name: repo-init
plugins.description: Bootstrap a GitHub repository with enterprise-grade defaults — branch protection (no direct push to main, require PR + N approvals, dismiss stale reviews), required CI status checks, squash-merge linear history, secret scanning, Dependabot alerts, and auto-delete of merged branches.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Audit, grade, and improve Claude Code skills and Cursor rules, and resolve overlap between them.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Anti-slop frontend design skills vendored from leonxlnx/taste-skill (MIT) — brief-driven design read, VARIANCE/MOTION/DENSITY dials, AI-tell ban list, redesign audit, style presets (soft, minimalist, brutalist, stitch), full-output enforcement, and image-gen reference skills (web, mobile, brandkit).

plugins.name: triple-lens-review
plugins.description: Three-lens code review — bugs, security, and performance — strongest on JavaScript/TypeScript/Python, applies to any language.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile — accessibility, layout, typography, components, and data visualization.
